We welcome: new members/residents, girl and boy children, nonlesbian women, dogs. entries.description: One lesbian owns 22 acres in north central Pennsylvania, half wooded and half clear, with a spring site and available electricity but no improvements. She lives in Philadelphia and wants people to develop the land under a long term lease.
entries.raw_text: SUSAN STONE 124 Maplewood Ave, Philadelphia, PA 19144. I have 22 acres of land in north central PA. There is a spring site, but it needs to be developed. The land is ½ wooded and ½ clear. Electricity is available. There are no improvements to the property. I would be interested in having people develop the land in return for a long term lease. I welcome: letters. I have/am: 1 lesbian, 22 acres, camping space, woods, farm land.
entries.notes: No community name; used person's name, which is also contact_name. Mailing address is a street address in Philadelphia, but land is described as in north central PA, so land street/city/zip blank; land_state PA. Type: one woman owns land -> Private/Individual Land. Residents 0: she lives in Philadelphia and there are 'no improvements to the property'. Accepted groups: only letters welcomed; Lesbian women assumed as the one lesbian owner is listed in 'I have/am: 1 lesbian'.

entries.description: A diverse, spiritually and politically conscious community of 10 lesbians on 20 acres, aiming to live in harmony with nature and be as self-sufficient as possible. Retreats, workshops, music and rituals already happen. A hexagon cabin is due by summer '83. Welcomes new members, girl children, boy children only the 2nd weekend of each month, and non-lesbian women who accept that men are not welcome and accept its lesbian identification.
entries.raw_text: TURTLE LAND FOR WIMMIN 719 N Irving St, Arlington, VA 22201 (703)527-7396. Our goal is to create a diverse, fun, spiritually and politically conscious community living in harmony with nature and as self-sufficient as possible. Some retreats, workshops, music, rituals, etc. are going on already. A one room hexagon cabin should be finished by Summer '83. We welcome: new members/residents, girl children, boy children (only the 2nd weekend of each month), nonlesbian women who accept that men are not welcome and accept our lesbian identification, dogs. We have/are: 10 lesbians, 20 acres, camping space, woods, women living and working on the land.
entries.notes: Mailing is a street address in Arlington VA, but land location is not stated and a cabin is only planned, so land fields blank. Type: community with 10 lesbians living and working on the land. Residents 10 from '10 lesbians' with 'women living and working on the land'. Boy children coded with condition 'only the 2nd weekend of each month'. Nonlesbian women welcome if they 'accept that men are not welcome'. Focuses: Spirituality/ritual ('spiritually... rituals'); Workshops/education ('retreats, workshops'); Archives/cultural work ('music'); Farming/self-sufficiency ('as self-sufficient as possible'). Environmentalism not coded since 'living in harmony with nature' alone is not enough. Lesbian separatism not coded: listing says 'men are not welcome' but welcomes non-lesbian women and boys part-time; not named as separatism.

entries.description: One lesbian owns 50 acres in Pittsboro, NC, isolated with big old trees, building a house and with an old house on the land. She does not live there yet but hopes to by next summer, and wants other women to join her and hopes to create a haven for older dykes. Welcomes new members/residents and girl children.
entries.raw_text: DUFFY Z BAUM PO Box 678, Carrboro, NC 27510 (919)942-5340. I own 50 acres of land in Pittsboro, NC. I am building a house on the land and also have an old house on the land. I do not live on my land but hope to by next summer. I am anxious to have other women join me on my land. The land is quite isolated and has some nice big old trees. I'd like to be a haven for older dykes. I welcome: new members/residents, girl children. I have/am: 1 lesbian, 50 acres, electricity, camping space, woods, farm land (questionable).
entries.notes: Name is a person's name, used as community_name and contact_name. PO box is not the land; land city Pittsboro stated ('50 acres of land in Pittsboro, NC'). Type: one woman owns land and does not live there yet -> Private/Individual Land. Residents 0: 'I do not live on my land'. Focus Older women: 'haven for older dykes'. Accepted: Lesbian women assumed; 'girl children' named. Acreage 50.

entries.description: Two lesbians on 2.3 acres with a small piece of land and the start of an organic garden, envisioning a community of women supporting each other emotionally, spiritually and financially through collective work. Visitors may stay a maximum of two nights. Welcomes girl and boy children, non-lesbian women and non oppressive males (not overnight). No drug addicts/alcoholics, kleptomaniacs or other disrespectful people.
entries.raw_text: ADLAI NEUBAUER & KAREN HAMM 3634 Loudon St, Granville, OH 43023 (614)587-4527. We are only beginning. We have a small piece of land and the start of an organic garden. We envision a community of women supporting each other emotionally, spiritually and financially through responsible collective work. Visitors should plan to stay a maximum of two nights unless a work exchange or other arrangements are made (2 week advance notice preferred). No drug addicts/alcoholics, kleptomaniacs, or other disrespectful people welcome. We welcome: girl and boy children, nonlesbian women, non oppressive males (not overnight), dogs. We have/are: 2 lesbians, 2.3 acres, housing/permanent structures, plumbing/electricity, camping space, farm land, women living on the land.

Residents 2 from '2 lesbians' with 'women living on the land'. Accepted: 'girl and boy children', 'nonlesbian women' named; 'non oppressive males (not overnight)' coded as Gay men and Non-gay men with the condition 'not overnight'.
